description: Finds every verse where a Hebrew or Greek word occurs, ignoring accents and cantillation (e.g. ἀγάπη, λόγος, חֶסֶד). Returns the source text and the translation side by side.

edition.description: Translation to show next to the source text.

language.description: Language for names, notes and study content: en, nb (Norwegian Bokmål), nn (Norwegian Nynorsk), sv, fr, es, fi, de. Content missing in a language falls back to English.

word.description: The word in Hebrew or Greek script.

name: search_original_word
title: Find a Hebrew or Greek word
